attributes.name: faq_answer_presentation
attributes.definition: How FAQ/Q&A content is presented with respect to expand/collapse behavior.

values.definition: Answers hidden behind expandable accordion toggles.
All answers visible at once, shown as stacked cards or blocks without accordion behavior.
Other treatment or no FAQ content.

attributes.name: faq_container_width
attributes.definition: Width of the main content column relative to the page for a content section.

values.definition: Content confined to a narrow column centered on the page.
Content spans the full container width.
Content occupies only part of the container, leaving one side empty.

attributes.name: header_hero_relationship
attributes.definition: How the header bar relates spatially to the hero section beneath/behind it.

values.definition: Header overlays the hero image, leaving an empty band or awkward spacing.
Header overlays the hero image without awkward spacing.
Header sits in its own band above the hero, not overlapping.

attributes.name: form_layout_balance
attributes.definition: How a form fills its container horizontally.

values.definition: Form spans the container width, balanced.
Form occupies only part of the container, leaving the other side empty.
Form or form-plus-companion content split into balanced columns.
